source_refs.note: Exercise 6.2, Question 5 (a)-(b): tangents from an external point and their points of contact; book p. 183, answers p. 305 (PDF 307)

blocks.prompt: 5 (a) Find the equations of the tangents drawn from the point \((-3, 7)\) to the circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 8\). Also find the points of contact.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan point circle ke bahar hai aur us se do tangents khinchte hain. Yeh bilkul Example 14 wala tareeqa hai.
Diya kya hai? Point \((-3, 7)\) aur circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 8\).
Find kya karna hai? Dono tangents aur un ke points of contact.
Rule kaunsa? Point se guzarne wali line slope \(m\) ke saath; tangent tab jab centre se faasla = radius.
Plan: \(m\) ki quadratic, do slopes, do lines; phir har line circle mein rakh kar repeated root se point.
steps:
Diya gaya: point \((-3, 7)\); circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 8\), centre \((0, 0)\), radius \(2\sqrt{2}\).
Maloom karna: tangents aur points of contact.
Tareeqa: Example 14 ki tarah: point se guzarne wali slope \(m\) ki line tab tangent hai jab centre se us ka faasla radius ke barabar ho.

Point bahar hai
\[(-3)^2 + 7^2 - 8 = 50 > 0\]
Kyun: 6.2.6: bahar wale point se do real tangents khinch sakte hain. Andar hota to koi tangent na hota, aur circle par hota to sirf ek. Yeh check pehle kar lena achhi aadat hai, taake pata ho ke kitne jawab dhoondne hain. Misaal: kisi gol mez ke bahar khare ho kar aap us ke dono kinaron ko chhooti hui do seedhi nazrein daal sakte hain.

\((-3, 7)\) se line
\[y - 7 = m(x + 3)\]
\[mx - y + 3m + 7 = 0 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Point-slope form; distance formula ke liye general form mein likha.

Origin se faasla = radius
\[\dfrac{|3m + 7|}{\sqrt{m^2 + 1}} = 2\sqrt{2}\]
\[(3m + 7)^2 = 8(m^2 + 1)\]
\[9m^2 + 42m + 49 = 8m^2 + 8\]
\[m^2 + 42m + 41 = 0\]
\[(m + 1)(m + 41) = 0\]
Kyun: \((0, 0)\) rakhne se numerator \(|3m + 7|\) bacha. Dono taraf square kiya; \((2\sqrt{2})^2 = 8\). \(1 \times 41 = 41\) aur \(1 + 41 = 42\), is liye factors \((m + 1)(m + 41)\).

Tangents
\[m = -1:\ -x - y - 3 + 7 = 0\]
\[x + y - 4 = 0\]
\[m = -41:\ -41x - y - 123 + 7 = 0\]
\[41x + y + 116 = 0\]
Kyun: Har slope ko (1) mein rakha aur \(-1\) se multiply kar ke saaf kiya.

\(x + y - 4 = 0\) ka point of contact
\[x^2 + (4 - x)^2 = 8\]
\[2x^2 - 8x + 8 = 0\]
\[(x - 2)^2 = 0,\quad x = 2,\ y = 2\]
Kyun: Tangent circle ko sirf ek point par milti hai, is liye quadratic ka double (repeated) root aata hai. \(x + y - 4 = 0\) se \(y = 4 - x\) circle mein rakha, phir 2 se divide kiya. Aakhir mein \(y = 4 - 2 = 2\).

\(41x + y + 116 = 0\) ka point of contact
\[x^2 + (41x + 116)^2 = 8\]
\[1682x^2 + 9512x + 13448 = 0\]
\[841x^2 + 4756x + 6724 = 0\]
\[(29x + 82)^2 = 0,\quad x = -\tfrac{82}{29}\]
\[y = -41\left(-\tfrac{82}{29}\right) - 116 = -\tfrac{2}{29}\]
Kyun: \(y = -41x - 116\) rakha. Numbers bare hain lekin pattern wohi: 2 se divide kiya to perfect square nikla, kyunke \(29^2 = 841\), \(82^2 = 6724\), \(2(29)(82) = 4756\). Phir \(y = \frac{3362 - 3364}{29}\).
Dhyan dein: Itne bare numbers dekh kar ghabrayein nahi; tangent hai to perfect square zaroor banega.

Tasdeeq
\[\left(\tfrac{82}{29}\right)^2 + \left(\tfrac{2}{29}\right)^2 = \tfrac{6728}{841} = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosra point of contact circle par hai (\(6724 + 4 = 6728 = 8 \times 841\)). \((2, 2)\) bhi: \(4 + 4 = 8\).
blocks.final_answer: \(x + y - 4 = 0\), point of contact \((2, 2)\); \(41x + y + 116 = 0\), point of contact \(\left(-\frac{82}{29}, -\frac{2}{29}\right)\).

answer_figure.alt: Circle x^2 + y^2 = 8 with the two tangents from (-3, 7): x + y - 4 = 0 touching at (2, 2) and 41x + y + 116 = 0 touching at (-82/29, -2/29).
answer_figure.caption: Tangents from (−3, 7) to x² + y² = 8 (original drawing).

blocks.prompt: 5 (b) Find the equations of the tangents drawn from the point \((12, -4)\) to the circle \(x^2 + y^2 - 4x - 2y - 20 = 0\). Also find the points of contact.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh part (a) wala hi tareeqa hai, bas circle general form mein hai, is liye pehle centre aur radius chahiye.
Diya kya hai? Point \((12, -4)\) aur circle \(x^2 + y^2 - 4x - 2y - 20 = 0\).
Find kya karna hai? Dono tangents aur points of contact.
Rule kaunsa? Centre se line ka faasla = radius.
Plan: centre, radius; slope \(m\) wali line; \(m\) ki equation; lines; phir har line circle mein rakh kar point.
steps:
Diya gaya: point \((12, -4)\); circle \(x^2 + y^2 - 4x - 2y - 20 = 0\).
Maloom karna: tangents aur points of contact.
Tareeqa: Example 14 ki tarah: centre \((-g, -f)\), radius \(\sqrt{g^2 + f^2 - c}\), aur shart "centre se faasla = radius".

Centre, radius aur point ki position
\[\text{centre} = (2, 1),\quad r = \sqrt{4 + 1 + 20} = 5\]
\[144 + 16 - 48 + 8 - 20 = 100 > 0\]
Kyun: \(g = -2\), \(f = -1\), \(c = -20\). Point ko circle ke left side mein rakha to positive aaya, yani point bahar hai aur do tangents milenge.

\((12, -4)\) se line
\[y + 4 = m(x - 12)\]
\[mx - y - 12m - 4 = 0 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: Point-slope form; \(y - (-4) = y + 4\).

\((2, 1)\) se faasla = 5
\[\dfrac{|2m - 1 - 12m - 4|}{\sqrt{m^2 + 1}} = 5\]
\[|10m + 5| = 5\sqrt{m^2 + 1}\]
\[(2m + 1)^2 = m^2 + 1\]
\[3m^2 + 4m = 0,\quad m = 0 \text{ or } -\tfrac{4}{3}\]
Kyun: Centre rakha: \(2m - 1 - 12m - 4 = -10m - 5\); modulus mein sign ka farq nahi parta. 5 se divide, square, phir \(4m^2 + 4m + 1 = m^2 + 1\) se \(m(3m + 4) = 0\).
Dhyan dein: \(m = 0\) ko ignore na karein; slope zero matlab horizontal tangent, jo bilkul jaiz hai.

Tangents
\[m = 0:\ y + 4 = 0\]
\[m = -\tfrac{4}{3}:\ 3(y + 4) = -4(x - 12)\]
\[4x + 3y - 36 = 0\]
Kyun: Har slope point-slope form mein rakha. Doosri mein 3 se multiply: \(3y + 12 = -4x + 48\), phir sab terms ek taraf: \(4x + 3y - 36 = 0\). Pehli line \(y = -4\) horizontal hai, aur figure mein saaf dikhta hai ke woh circle ke sab se neeche wale point \((2, -4)\) ko chhooti hai.

\(y + 4 = 0\) ka point of contact
\[x^2 + 16 - 4x + 8 - 20 = 0\]
\[(x - 2)^2 = 0,\quad (2, -4)\]
Kyun: \(y = -4\) circle mein rakha: \(x^2 - 4x + 4 = 0\), repeated root \(x = 2\).

Tasdeeq
\[(6, 4):\ 36 + 16 - 24 - 8 - 20 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[(2, -4):\ 4 + 16 - 8 + 8 - 20 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono points circle par hain; aur \((2, 1)\) se \(4x + 3y - 36 = 0\) ka faasla \(\frac{|8 + 3 - 36|}{5} = 5\), radius ke barabar.
blocks.final_answer: \(y + 4 = 0\), point of contact \((2, -4)\); \(4x + 3y - 36 = 0\), point of contact \((6, 4)\).

answer_figure.alt: Circle with centre (2, 1) and radius 5 with the two tangents from (12, -4): y + 4 = 0 touching at (2, -4) and 4x + 3y - 36 = 0 touching at (6, 4).
answer_figure.caption: Tangents from (12, −4) to x² + y² − 4x − 2y − 20 = 0 (original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein Question 5 ke jawab key 6 ke taur par chhape hain aur un ke labels parts se nahi milte: key 6 (a) aur 6 (b) dono part (a) ke do tangents hain, \(x + y - 4 = 0\) at \((2, 2)\) aur \(41x + y + 116 = 0\) at \(\left(-\frac{82}{29}, -\frac{2}{29}\right)\); aur key 6 (c) asal mein part (b) hai, \(y + 4 = 0\) at \((2, -4)\) aur \(4x + 3y - 36 = 0\) at \((6, 4)\). Values sab sahi hain.
